drivingQuestion: May a person still pray for mercy once a decree of death has been pronounced against him?
outcomeNote: Hezekiah's tradition — that one never desists from praying for mercy — stands, and the setama supports it with the joint dictum of R' Yoḥanan and R' Eliezer proved from Job 13:15; Isaiah's 'the decree is already issued' is not sustained.

segments.he: אָמַר רַב הַמְנוּנָא: מַאי דִּכְתִיב ״מִי כְּהֶחָכָם וּמִי יוֹדֵעַ פֵּשֶׁר דָּבָר״ — מִי כְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ לַעֲשׂוֹת פְּשָׁרָה בֵּין שְׁנֵי צַדִּיקִים, בֵּין חִזְקִיָּהוּ לִישַׁעְיָהוּ. חִזְקִיָּהוּ אֲמַר: לֵיתֵי יְשַׁעְיָהוּ גַּבַּאי, דְּהָכִי אַשְׁכְּחַן בְּאֵלִיָּהוּ דַּאֲזַל לְגַבֵּי אַחְאָב, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וַיֵּלֶךְ אֵלִיָּהוּ לְהֵרָאוֹת אֶל אַחְאָב״. יְשַׁעְיָהוּ אֲמַר: לֵיתֵי חִזְקִיָּהוּ גַּבַּאי דְּהָכִי אַשְׁכְּחַן בִּיהוֹרָם בֶּן אַחְאָב דַּאֲזַל לְגַבֵּי אֱלִישָׁע.
segments.en: With regard to redemption and prayer, the Gemara tells the story of Hezekiah’s illness, his prayer to God, and subsequent recuperation. «Rav Hamnuna said: What is» the meaning of «that which is written» praising the Holy One, Blessed be He: «“Who is like the wise man, and who knows the interpretation [pesher] of the matter”» (Ecclesiastes 8:1)? This verse means: «Who is like the Holy One, Blessed be He, Who knows how to effect compromise [peshara] between two righteous individuals, between Hezekiah,» the king of Judea, «and Isaiah» the prophet. They disagreed over which of them should visit the other. «Hezekiah said: Let Isaiah come to me, as that is what we find with regard to Elijah» the prophet, «who went to Ahab,» the king of Israel, «as it is stated: “And Elijah went to appear to Ahab”» (I Kings 18:2). This proves that it is the prophet who must seek out the king. «And Isaiah said: Let Hezekiah come to me, as that is what we find with regard to Yehoram ben Ahab,» king of Israel, «who went to Elisha» the prophet, as it is stated: “So the king of Israel, Jehosaphat and the king of Edom went down to him” (II Kings 3:12).

segments.he: מָה עָשָׂה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא — הֵבִיא יִסּוּרִים עַל חִזְקִיָּהוּ, וְאָמַר לוֹ לִישַׁעְיָהוּ: לֵךְ וּבַקֵּר אֶת הַחוֹלֶה. שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם חָלָה חִזְקִיָּהוּ לָמוּת וַיָּבֹא אֵלָיו יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶּן אָמוֹץ הַנָּבִיא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו כֹּה אָמַר ה׳ צְבָאוֹת צַו לְבֵיתֶךָ כִּי מֵת אַתָּה וְלֹא תִחְיֶה וְגוֹ׳״. מַאי ״כִּי מֵת אַתָּה וְלֹא תִחְיֶה״: מֵת אַתָּה — בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה, וְלֹא תִחְיֶה — לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא.
segments.en: «What did the Holy One, Blessed be He, do» to effect compromise between Hezekiah and Isaiah? «He brought the suffering» of illness «upon Hezekiah and told Isaiah: Go and visit the sick.» Isaiah did as God instructed, «as it is stated: “In those days Hezekiah became deathly ill, and Isaiah ben Amoz the prophet came and said to him: Thus says the Lord of Hosts: Set your house in order, for you will die and you will not live”» (Isaiah 38:1). This seems redundant; «what is» the meaning of «you will die and you will not live?» This repetition means: «You will die in this world, and you will not live,» you will have no share, «in the World-to-Come.»

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מַאי כּוּלֵּי הַאי? אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מִשּׁוּם דְּלָא עֲסַקְתְּ בִּפְרִיָּה וּרְבִיָּה. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: מִשּׁוּם דַּחֲזַאי לִי בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ דְּנָפְקִי מִינַּאי בְּנִין דְּלָא מְעַלּוּ.
segments.en: Hezekiah «said to him: What is all of this?» For what transgression am I being punished? Isaiah «said to him: Because you did not» marry and «engage in procreation.» Hezekiah apologized and «said:» I had no children «because I envisaged through divine inspiration that the children that emerge from me will not be virtuous.» Hezekiah meant that he had seen that his children were destined to be evil. In fact, his son Menashe sinned extensively, and he thought it preferable to have no children at all.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: בַּהֲדֵי כַּבְשֵׁי דְרַחֲמָנָא לְמָה לָךְ? מַאי דְּמִפַּקְּדַתְּ אִיבְּעִי לָךְ לְמֶעְבַּד, וּמָה דְנִיחָא קַמֵּיהּ קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא — לַעֲבֵיד.
segments.en: Isaiah «said to him: Why do you» involve «yourself with the secrets of the Holy One, Blessed be He? That which you have been commanded,» the mitzva of procreation, «you are required to perform, and that which is acceptable» in the eyes of «the Holy One, Blessed be He, let Him perform,» as He has so decided.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: הַשְׁתָּא הַב לִי בְּרַתָּךְ, אֶפְשָׁר דְּגָרְמָא זְכוּתָא דִידִי וְדִידָךְ, וְנָפְקִי מִנַּאי בְּנִין דִּמְעַלּוּ. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: כְּבָר נִגְזְרָה עָלֶיךָ גְּזֵירָה. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: בֶּן אָמוֹץ, כַּלֵּה נְבוּאָתְךָ וָצֵא!
segments.en: Hezekiah «said to» Isaiah: «Now give me your daughter» as my wife; «perhaps my merit and your merit will cause virtuous children to emerge from me.» Isaiah «said to him: The decree has already been decreed against you» and this judgment cannot be changed. Hezekiah «said to him: Son of Amoz, cease your prophecy and leave.» As long as the prophet spoke as God’s emissary, Hezekiah was obligated to listen to him. He was not, however, obligated to accept Isaiah’s personal opinion that there was no possibility for mercy and healing.

segments.he: כָּךְ מְקּוּבְּלַנִי מִבֵּית אֲבִי אַבָּא, אֲפִילּוּ חֶרֶב חַדָּה מוּנַּחַת עַל צַוָּארוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם, אַל יִמְנַע עַצְמוֹ מִן הָרַחֲמִים.
segments.en: Hezekiah continued: «I have received a tradition from the house of my father’s father,» from King David, the founding father of the dynasty of kings of Judea: «Even» if «a sharp sword rests upon a person’s neck, he should not prevent himself from» praying for «mercy.» One may still hold out hope that his prayers will be answered, as was David himself when he saw the Angel of Destruction, but nonetheless prayed for mercy and his prayers were answered.

segments.he: אִתְּמַר נָמֵי, רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן וְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר דְאָמְרִי תַּרְוַיְיהוּ: אֲפִילּוּ חֶרֶב חַדָּה מוּנַּחַת עַל צַוָּארוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם, אַל יִמְנַע עַצְמוֹ מִן הָרַחֲמִים. שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״הֵן יִקְטְלֵנִי לוֹ אֲיַחֵל״.
segments.en: With regard to the fact that one should not despair of God’s mercy, the Gemara cites that «it was also said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan and Rabbi Eliezer both said: Even if a sharp sword is resting upon a person’s neck, he should not prevent himself from» praying for «mercy, as it is stated» in the words of Job: «“Though He slay me, I will trust in Him”» (Job 13:15). Even though God is about to take his life, he still prays for God’s mercy.

moves.summary: expounds Ecclesiastes 8:1 as praise of God, who knows how to effect a compromise between two righteous men

moves.summary: holds the opposite, as Yehoram went to Elisha

moves.summary: God resolves the standoff by making Hezekiah ill and sending Isaiah to visit the sick
moves.about: the instruction to go and visit the sick Hezekiah, which resolves the standoff

moves.summary: glosses the doubled wording: death in this world and no share in the World-to-Come

moves.summary: asks for what sin so total a punishment is decreed
moves.about: for what transgression so severe a punishment is decreed

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: משום דלא עסקת בפריה ורביה
moves.summary: answers: because he did not engage in procreation
moves.about: that the decree is because Hezekiah did not engage in procreation

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: משום דחזאי לי ברוח הקדש
moves.summary: justifies himself: he foresaw that unworthy sons would issue from him
moves.about: his reason for not procreating — he foresaw by divine inspiration that unworthy children would issue from him

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: בהדי כבשי דרחמנא למה לך?
moves.summary: attacks the excuse: God's secrets are not his business; he owed the commandment
moves.about: whether foreknowledge of unworthy offspring excuses neglect of the commandment to procreate

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: השתא הב לי ברתך
moves.summary: floats a remedy: marry Isaiah's daughter, so that their joint merit may yield worthy sons
moves.about: asking for Isaiah's daughter in marriage, in the hope that their joint merit will yield worthy sons

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: כבר נגזרה עליך גזירה
moves.summary: knocks down the proposal: the decree has already been issued
moves.about: whether the marriage could still avert the decree already issued

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: בן אמוץ, כלה נבואתך וצא!
moves.summary: dismisses the prophet, refusing to accept his private opinion as final
moves.about: dismissing the prophet once he speaks his own opinion rather than God's message

moves.summary: grounds his refusal in a tradition of the house of David: even with a sword at one's neck, do not desist from mercy
moves.about: the received tradition that one must not desist from praying for mercy even with a sword at his neck

moves.cueHe: אתמר נמי, רבי יוחנן ורבי אליעזר דאמרי תרוייהו
moves.summary: adduces the joint dictum of R' Yoḥanan and R' Eliezer, in the same words, in support
moves.about: the amoraic dictum that one never desists from praying for mercy

moves.summary: proves the dictum from Job's words: though He slay me, I will trust in Him
moves.about: Job's words as proof that one prays even as God is about to slay him
